methods.name: private static int firstDifferingByteIndexNativeEndian(long left, long right)
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the first byte where left and right differ, in the range [0, 8]. If {@code * left == right}, the result will be 8, otherwise less than 8. * *

This counts from the *first* byte, which may be the most or least significant byte depending * on the system endianness.

methods.name: static int mismatch(byte[] left, int leftOff, byte[] right, int rightOff, int length)
methods.comment:
* Returns the lowest {@code index} such that {@code 0 <= index < length} and {@code left[leftOff * + index] != right[rightOff + index]}. If no such value exists -- if {@code left} and {@code * right} match up to {@code length} bytes from their respective offsets -- returns -1. * *

{@code leftOff + length} must be less than or equal to {@code left.length}, and the same for * {@code right}.
